# Renux 0.1.1 "Aurora"

**Renux 0.1.1 "Aurora", the first update of Renux 0.1, built with Zig 0.17.1.** A general-purpose operating system, easy to
maintain and portable, built with Zig alone: install Zig, build the whole
system.

> [!WARNING]
> Renux 0.1.1 is experimental. Do not install it on a machine that holds data
> you need. It is amd64 and UEFI only. The installer offers Auto (UFS) and
> Auto (ZFS).

## What is in it

- The kernel, the EFI loader and the whole userland are built by `zig build`
  from the Renux source tree, with Zig 0.17.1 as the compiler.
- Renux is based on FreeBSD 15.1 and follows FreeBSD's development.
- The kernel modules are built and installed in `/boot/modules` (854 on
  amd64), including ZFS and the drivers FreeBSD ships as modules.
- The installer offers **Auto (UFS)** and **Auto (ZFS)**; ZFS includes the
  kernel module, `zpool`/`zfs` and the loader support.
- Zig is the system's compiler: `zig`, `cc` and `c++` compile Zig, C and C++
  from the first boot.
- The installer speaks English, Spanish and Portuguese. It sets up the
  network and can install the package manager (`pkg`) from the Internet, so
  that `pkg install` works from the first boot.
- The console:
  - the text cursor is an underline;
  - full-screen programs (`vi`, `less`, `htop`) get a screen of their own and
    give the previous one back when they quit;
  - `clear` also empties the history.
- The login welcomes to Renux.

## Known limitations

- amd64 and UEFI only: Renux does not boot by BIOS (CSM, Legacy).
- The installer offers Auto (UFS) and Auto (ZFS); the ZFS menu configures
  the pool, datasets and optional encryption.
- In Spanish and Portuguese, the names of keymaps and of most time zones are
  still in English.
- The system's compiler, Zig 0.17.1 (with `cc`, `c++`, `ld`, `ar` and `ranlib`,
  which run it), is ziglang.org's build for FreeBSD; it is not yet built from
  the Renux tree.

## Files

| File | What it is |
| ---- | ---------- |
| `@NAME@-installer.iso.xz` | The installer for a DVD: it boots into the Renux installer, which sets up the disk and the network and installs the system. |
| `@NAME@-memstick.img.xz` | The installer for a USB stick or an external disk: a GPT disk with an EFI system partition and a UFS root, written with `dd`. |
| `@NAME@.img.xz` | A disk with the system ready, for a virtual machine or to write to a disk. |
| `SHA256` | The sha256 of the three. |

## Check and unpack

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256
unxz @NAME@-installer.iso.xz
unxz @NAME@-memstick.img.xz
```

To write the memstick to a USB stick or an external disk, which erases it:

```sh
sudo dd if=@NAME@-memstick.img of=/dev/da0 bs=1m conv=fsync
sudo gpart recover da0   # if the target is larger than the image
```

Boot the target by UEFI, not by BIOS (CSM, Legacy).
